<p class="eyebrow">Teaching</p>

# Connecting economic reasoning to real estate decisions.

At Cal State Fullerton, I teach courses in real estate principles and investment analysis, with an emphasis on applied market evidence, financial modeling, and professional practice.

## Current courses {#current-courses}

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.course-card}
<span class="course-code">FIN 351</span>

## Real Estate Principles

An introduction to property rights, markets, finance, valuation, brokerage, and the institutions that shape real estate decisions.
:::

::: {.course-card}
<span class="course-code">FIN 355</span>

## Real Estate Investment Analysis

Applied analysis of property cash flows, financing, risk, valuation, and investment decisions using spreadsheet models and case-based work.
:::
:::

## Interactive teaching tools {#interactive-teaching-tools}

These browser-based tools support core concepts in **FIN 355: Real Estate Investment Analysis**. They are designed for classroom demonstration and independent exploration.

::: {.tool-grid}
::: {.tool-card}
<span class="tool-topic">FIN 355 · Debt financing</span>

### How Amortization Changes a Loan Payment

Explore how each level mortgage payment is divided between interest and principal, and how the principal share rises over the loan term.

[Open the amortization tool](https://desenlin.com/FIN355/amortization.html){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.tool-card}
<span class="tool-topic">FIN 355 · Commercial debt underwriting</span>

### Commercial Mortgage Loan Sizing

Compare the loan ceilings implied by LTV, DSCR, and debt yield, identify the binding constraint, and see how underwriting assumptions change the maximum permitted loan.

[Open the loan sizing tool](https://desenlin.com/FIN355/loan-sizing.html){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.tool-card}
<span class="tool-topic">FIN 355 · Investment returns</span>

### Internal Rate of Return as a Zero-NPV Solution

Visualize IRR as a zero-NPV solution, edit annual cash flows, and see why nonconventional cash flows may produce multiple IRRs or no real IRR.

[Open the IRR tool](https://desenlin.com/FIN355/irr.html){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.tool-card}
<span class="tool-topic">FIN 355 · Structured finance</span>

### CMBS Tranching and the First-Loss Waterfall

Build a CMBS capital stack, trace losses from junior to senior bonds, and connect tranche yields to pool pricing and lender economics.

[Open the CMBS tranching tool](https://desenlin.com/FIN355/cmbs-tranching.html){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.tool-card}
<span class="tool-topic">FIN 355 · Commercial leases</span>

### Net Effective Rent and Lease NPV

See how concessions change annual net effective rent, then compare constant rent growth with a delayed rent bump using multi-year landlord NPV.

[Open the net effective rent tool](https://desenlin.com/FIN355/net-effective-rent.html){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.tool-card}
<span class="tool-topic">FIN 355 · Development feasibility</span>

### Development Feasibility: Replacement Rent and Land Value

Solve the same development model in two directions: find the minimum rent that supports a land cost or the maximum land price supported by market rent.

[Open the development feasibility tool](https://desenlin.com/FIN355/development-feasibility.html){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::
:::
